scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A familiar voice
scenes.caption: Asha receives a fictional call that sounds like a relative. The caller says there is an emergency and demands an immediate private transfer. A familiar voice feels convincing, but it does not independently verify identity or the payment request.
scenes.dialogue: Can we check without following the caller’s instructions?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Pressure on the call
scenes.caption: The caller insists that Asha must not tell anyone and gives a new number to confirm the story. The same person would then control both the claim and its supposed verification. An intimidating authority claim can use the same pattern.
scenes.dialogue: A second number from the caller is not independent.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Use known channels
scenes.caption: Calmly end the call. Contact the relative through a previously known route and involve a trusted adult. A second independent person or channel can help resolve the claim. Do not pay while identity and circumstances remain uncertain.
scenes.dialogue: Verification can be calm and supportive.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the response
scenes.caption: The voice sounds convincing and the caller asks for secrecy. Should Asha make a small test payment, stay on the line for instructions, or end the call and check through a known contact?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: The claim is checked
scenes.caption: Asha ends the call and uses her saved contact rather than a new number supplied by the caller. She asks a trusted adult to help check the situation separately. If one route fails, uncertainty remains; it does not authorise payment.
scenes.dialogue: An unanswered call is not confirmation.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the call lab
scenes.caption: Rehearse the first two decisions, build a two-channel verification plan and choose a calm response to a new authority claim. No real voice clone, call or transfer is created.
scenes.dialogue: A safe script helps when emotions rise.
